collection.description: Three birds land together on a villager's roof, and an old family saying says a visitor is coming.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's an old saying in (subject)'s family: when three birds land on your roof together, a visitor is coming. This morning three birds land on (subject)'s roof, side by side, and sit there looking down at (subject.him/her). (subject) looks up at them. Then, slowly, (subject.he/she) starts to tidy the hut.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) shakes (subject.his/her) head and gets on with (subject.his/her) day. Three birds are just three birds. Nobody comes. In the evening, though, (subject) catches (subject.him/her)self glancing down the path, just once or twice. The birds are back on the roof the next morning. (subject) decides not to count them.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) sweeps, puts out fruit and changes into (subject.his/her) good clothes. (friend) wanders past and asks who's coming. "I don't know yet," says (subject). Nobody comes all day. Then, just at sunset, (visitor), a visitor from another village, turns up, looking for somewhere to stay the night. (subject) feels very smug. (friend) points out that visitors come quite often. (subject) feels very smug anyway.
